p.THE-DEFAULT-POSTURE-ON-THE-COMMIT-AND-PU: The default posture for how much an agent decides on its own versus stops to ask, on the **commit and push** surface.

p.ROUTINE-LARGE-CHANGES-PROCEED-WITHOUT-A-: Routine large changes proceed and are committed/pushed **without** a confirmation handshake:

item.ROUTINE-TOUCHING-MANY-FILES-FOR-ONE-REAS: touching many files for one coherent reason.

p.the-approval-was-given-upstream: The approval was given upstream, when the work was authorised; a mid-work "shall I proceed?" is overhead already paid for.

p.ASK-FIRST-FOR-ANYTHING-WHOSE-REVERSAL-CO: Ask first for anything whose reversal costs work:

item.RED-LINE-REWRITING-PUBLISHED-HISTORY: rewriting published history (rebase of pushed commits, `git commit --amend` on pushed work);

item.RED-LINE-CI-SIGNING-OR-SECRETS: changing CI, signing, or secrets configuration;

item.RED-LINE-ANYTHING-WHOSE-REVERSAL-WOULD-C: **any operation whose reversal would cost work.**
